Layer.OnCommand: %function(self) self:diffusealpha(0) SongTitle(self) self:zoom(0.5) self:x(SCREEN_CENTER_X) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y-190) self:shadowlength(0) self:accelerate(0.5) self:diffusealpha(1) self:maxwidth(800) end

%function(self) self:horizalign('right') self:x(SCREEN_CENTER_X-90+35) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y+80+17) self:zoom(0.6) self:diffuse(1,0,0,1) self:addx(-SCREEN_WIDTH/2) self:sleep(0.6) self:queuecommand('CalcMine') self:decelerate(0.3) self:addx(SCREEN_WIDTH/2) self:shadowlength(0) end
Layer.CalcMineCommand: %function(self) local MineTxt = SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen():GetChild('MinesTextP1'):GetText() local MinePass = string.gsub(MineTxt, '/.*', '') MinePass = string.gsub(MinePass,' ','') local MineTotal = string.gsub(MineTxt, '^.*/', '') MineTotal = string.gsub(MineTotal,' ','') local MineHit = tostring(tonumber(MineTotal) - tonumber(MinePass)) if tonumber(MineHit) > 0 then self:settext('+'..MineHit) end end

Layer.OnCommand: %function(self) self:horizalign('left') self:x(SCREEN_CENTER_X+90-35) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y+80+17) self:zoom(0.6) self:diffuse(1,0,0,1) self:addx(SCREEN_WIDTH/2) self:sleep(0.6) self:queuecommand('CalcMine') self:decelerate(0.3) self:addx(-SCREEN_WIDTH/2) self:shadowlength(0) end
Layer.CalcMineCommand: %function(self) local MineTxt = SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen():GetChild('MinesTextP2'):GetText() local MinePass = string.gsub(MineTxt, '/.*', '') MinePass = string.gsub(MinePass,' ','') local MineTotal = string.gsub(MineTxt, '^.*/', '') MineTotal = string.gsub(MineTotal,' ','') local MineHit = tostring(tonumber(MineTotal) - tonumber(MinePass)) if tonumber(MineHit) > 0 then self:settext('+'..MineHit) end end
